title: Automation: closing the loop with valve control
talking_points: Canopy can connect directly to a farm's existing valve controllers.
When a field crosses its moisture threshold, Canopy can open or close the right valve automatically.
A team can also keep every decision manual and only use Canopy for visibility.

content.headline: Automatic where you want it, manual where you don't

narrator_guidance: Close the How It Works chapter here. Make clear automation is optional, not required.
